content: SSRF via OG-tag fetching: when a service fetches a user-submitted target URL to scrape og:title/og:description/og:image (or for bot-triggered social previews), the fetch must not be treated as a trusted internal request. Attack vectors: redirect chains that end in file://, ftp://, or internal/metadata IPs (169.254.169.254, localhost, RFC1918 ranges); DNS rebinding after initial validation. Prevention: resolve DNS and validate the IP is public/non-internal before connecting (recheck after redirects, cap redirect count, disable following to non-http(s) schemes), use an allowlisted egress proxy or dedicated fetch microservice with network-level egress filtering, set strict timeouts and response size caps, and never reflect raw fetched content back into the dashboard without sanitizing.
